display_name: Practical 同路线源域扩样与稀疏算子复评
description: Same fixed R07 evaluation and sparse model family. Refit from 768 archived Practical Residual source-U packets plus 192 distinct U holdout packets.
authorization: 2026-11-26 continue user-directed receive-only Practical estimation. Current thresholds overall mean <0.5%, Low Urban mean <1%, Low Urban P90 <2%; report P95.

data.version: Original R07 archive and matched fixed V probe panel
data.physical_ids_ref: Source-U physical indices selected with seed 2026112606. R07 frozen V remains 128 packets and seed 2026112601.
data.train_ratio: 768 fit and 192 held physically disjoint U; one archived Practical Residual view per packet and scene; earlier 144 receive-only developer packets excluded.
data.split_id: WiSig immutable source U and V; no target
data.support_query_ref: N/A Phase1; experiment has no support set

permissions.claim_scope: Preparation reads scene membership, source roles and physical ID metadata solely to export admissible Practical received IQ, excluding clean and older U physical packets. Estimation reads only post-Practical U/one current V packet and frozen prior. R07 truth loaded only by scorer after complete predictions.

checkpoint.initialization: Prior r01/r03/r04 fit on previously disjoint receive-only U; new soft sparse and mixed FIR fits use fresh same-route received U.
checkpoint.selection_rule: 768 fixed source U training packets, 192 fixed source U for ridge selection against dense and sparse proxy teachers. Keep fixed reference and probes and report both candidates.

execution.gpu_policy: Single CPU thread for fit/inference and per-packet latency. No GPU.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on input contract, numeric failure, estimator output completeness or wrong scorer closure.

rows.seed_notes: New physically disjoint U selection seed 2026112606. Source V and test probes keep exact prior seed 2026112601.
rows.scenario: Archived R07 six original Practical Residual conditions. Same 128 source-V physical IDs and two probes per physical ID.
rows.budget_ref: Reuse archived six-scene received views. Single CPU source fit and current-packet inference.
